title: Tencent AI Campus Recruiting 100-Point Evaluation Rubric

dimensions.criteria: Clear alignment with Algorithm Research, Inference Engineering, AI PM, or Domain+AI. Zero generic 'I love AI' fluff.
Demonstrated natural language scene deconstruction, badcase sensitivity, and Golden Set evaluation benchmark awareness.
Working prototype/demo with clear justification of why AI is necessary, token/latency economics, and user feedback.
Withstands multi-turn grilling without reciting pre-canned answers. Demonstrates genuine curiosity, self-driven growth, and resilience.
